record.name: Gadgeteer
record.description: Bounty Hunter Gadgeteers are masters of specialized equipment and technology, using advanced tracking devices, weapon modifications, and tactical gear to gain the upper hand in any hunt.

subclass_identity_profile.role_in_group: Master of Gadgeteered Technology and Equipment

effects.notes: Upon character creation, you focus your mind on a specific device or machine. Your eyes glaze over as the intricacies of its mechanisms become clear to you, granting you proficiency in one type of device or machine.

As a burst of creative energy, you intuitively improve and refine your gadgets, granting yourself expertise in one device or machine. You may also create a new gadget at the start of each day using basic materials.

As you touch a device or machine, the tinkerer's spark within you ignites, and your expertise shines through. You can use your proficiency bonus to improve a device or machine, and you may also create two new gadgets at the start of each day using basic materials.

As you land a critical hit, your quick mind sparks an innovative idea. You may use your proficiency bonus to improve a device or machine on yourself, and at the start of each day, you can create three new gadgets using basic materials.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a fluid, adaptable stance with a focus on agility and quick reflexes, reminiscent of a seasoned tracker navigating the dense forests of Endor.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounds itself with a pulsating aura of blue-white energy, evoking the hum of a well-tuned droid's power cell and hinting at a deep connection to technology and innovation.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate an image of a seasoned Gadgeteer (bounty hunter) Tinkerer, armed with trusty Scavenger's Scope and an assortment of Tinkerer's Tools, navigating the mist-shrouded swamps of Dagobah in pursuit of a rare and elusive target.
contextual_modifiers: captured in a moment of intense focus
with a subtle hint of playful curiosity
